title: Cheesy Sausage & Pepper Breakfast Scramble
description: A delicious and hearty breakfast scramble with sausage, peppers, eggs, and cheese.
steps: In a large skillet, brown the sausage over medium heat until it’s fully cooked and no longer pink.
Add the diced red bell pepper to the skillet and cook until the pepper is softened, about 3–4 minutes.
Crack the eggs directly into the skillet over the sausage and peppers. Stir everything together gently, scrambling the eggs until they’re fully cooked and everything is nicely combined.
Sprinkle the fiesta blend cheese over the top and let it melt in. Add a drizzle of Sriracha sauce (or more if you like a kick) and give it one last stir.
Serve hot and enjoy your cheesy, spicy breakfast scramble!
notes: Nutrition: Serving 1 serving · Calories 350 kcal · Fat 28g · Saturated fat 10g · Unsaturated fat 16g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 280mg · Sodium 800mg · Carbs 5g · Fiber 1g · Sugar 3g · Protein 25g

healthy: Eggs and sausage give lots of protein.
not_healthy: Breakfast sausage is processed meat high in sodium and saturated fat.
Shredded cheese adds more saturated fat and sodium.
